task: Design audit 2026-09-28 B2: End Game asked twice in words; Stop for today saves the class paused and stops the server; the next launch opens it paused and Resume goes on (docs/HOST_PAGE.md §2.7).
environment: Same computer: two local classroom servers one after the other on one save file, at 200 ms a tick, five families joined by request, headless Chrome. The server's stop is a callback here; the launcher's own exit is Stop Server's, proved by tests/lifecycle.test.mjs. Not a physical LAN or a classroom.
checks: while the class runs the Host offers pause, stop-for-today, end: Stop for today beside End Game, and no bare Stop Server

one press of End Game ends nothing: it reads "Confirm: end the whole game" and the page says "This ends the whole game for everyone and shows the ending. It can't be undone. To stop at the bell and carry on next class, use Stop for today instead."
left alone, End Game disarms itself and its words go; the class runs on

Stop for today, pressed twice, saves the class paused at minute 620 and stops the server; the page says "Your teacher stopped the class for today. It was saved and paused just as it stands, and it goes on from here next class."
the next launch opens the same class paused where it stopped ("10.3 hours · paused"), offering resume, stop-for-today, end
Resume carries the class on from where it stopped
at 400 px the Host page does not scroll sideways

endArmed.label: Confirm: end the whole game
endArmed.notice: This ends the whole game for everyone and shows the ending. It can't be undone. To stop at the bell and carry on next class, use Stop for today instead.

todayArmed.label: Confirm: save and stop for today
todayArmed.notice: This pauses the class and saves it where it stands, then closes the server. Next class, open the Host as usual: the class is there, paused, and Resume carries on.

measured.told: Your teacher stopped the class for today. It was saved and paused just as it stands, and it goes on from here next class.
